units.source_text: 水也好，空气也好，所有的流动物都会引起乱流。

en.t: Whether water or air, every flowing substance gives rise to turbulence.

units.source_text: 这种乱流的最小波长几乎与沙漠的沙子直径相等。

en.t: The smallest wavelength of this turbulence is almost equal to the diameter of desert sand grains.

units.source_text: 根据这个特性，只有沙子从泥土中被特别挑选出来，与流动形成直角方向才能被抽取出来。

en.t: Because of this property, only sand can be specially selected out from the soil and extracted in a direction at right angles to the flow.

units.source_text: 要是泥土的结合力薄弱的话，来一阵微风，甭说将石头吹起，

en.t: If the binding force of the soil is weak, then when a slight breeze comes, let alone lifting stones,

units.source_text: 就连黏土也飞不起来，但沙子却会一下子被吸上天空，

en.t: even clay cannot fly up, but sand will be sucked into the sky all at once,

units.source_text: 又被抛回地面，迎着风向被挪来挪去。

en.t: then thrown back to the ground and shifted back and forth against the wind.

units.source_text: 沙子的特性像是属于专门的流体力学问题。

en.t: The properties of sand seem to belong to a specialized problem in fluid dynamics.
